eyebrow: The problem: too many distinct values
code:
Amount:  12,400   87,000
         230,000  5,600 ...

Group by Amount?
  -> one group per exact number
  -> useless
caption: Raw values rarely make good groupings.

eyebrow: A bucket field is a CASE expression
code:
CASE
  WHEN Amount < 25000  THEN 'Small'
  WHEN Amount < 100000 THEN 'Medium'
  ELSE 'Large'
END AS DealSize
caption: Same logic, built with clicks, living only in the report.
